task: Test whether the surviving Outcome Economics differentiation remains unoccupied after James's fresh 402 Index evidence

competitors.name: 402 Index
competitors.observed_boundary: Published API documentation exposes discovery, pre-purchase health/reliability and payment-handshake fields; it does not document post-settlement task acceptance, paid-call correctness, retries, settled spend per accepted result, or provider ranking from those post-purchase outcomes.

competitors.name: x402-list
competitors.observed_boundary: Its published assessment explicitly says reliability is measured on the unpaid 402 handshake, not the paid call, and warns a service can return 402 correctly yet still fail after payment.

clarified_decision: The defensible benchmark hypothesis is narrower than discovery/reliability/price routing: measure identical locked-task post-settlement outcomes and rank on retry-adjusted effective cost per acceptable result. Current reviewed competitor evidence does not show that capability. Do not claim uniqueness beyond this evidence boundary.
next_validation_gate: Once bounded payment capability is independently connected, collect raw paid-call artifacts for the locked task: selected provider/payTo, quoted and settled amount, attempt count, paid latency, deterministic acceptance result, retry reason, and effective cost per acceptable result; compare provider choice against a pre-purchase match+health+price baseline.
